# BullPen

> BullPen is an investment research and portfolio-tracking platform for beginner-to-intermediate
> investors. It combines real-time market data, AI-powered analysis, and educational content in a
> single web app, positioned against Bloomberg-terminal-style density: a small number of clearly
> explained things rather than every metric at once.

BullPen is not a registered investment advisor and does not give personalized financial advice or
execute trades. Content is for informational and educational purposes only.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://bullpeninvest.com/): overview, pricing, and how the product works.
- [Pricing](https://bullpeninvest.com/upgrade): Free plan (unlimited stock pages, screener, holdings tracking, 5 AI questions a day) and Pro (Daily Brief, "Why Today?" price explanations for any stock, 150 AI questions a day, brokerage sync).
- [Stock directory](https://bullpeninvest.com/stocks): every S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 stock, each with a page such as [Apple](https://bullpeninvest.com/stock/AAPL) (health grade, key numbers in plain English) and subpages for [dividends](https://bullpeninvest.com/stock/AAPL/dividends), [Congress trades](https://bullpeninvest.com/stock/AAPL/congress-trades) and [fund holders](https://bullpeninvest.com/stock/AAPL/fund-holders).
- [Congress trades](https://bullpeninvest.com/discover/politicians): stock trades disclosed by members of Congress and senior officials, with a page per politician.
- [Fund portfolios](https://bullpeninvest.com/discover/institutions): what famous funds (Berkshire Hathaway, Bridgewater and others) hold, from their 13F filings.
- [Compare stocks](https://bullpeninvest.com/tools/compare/aapl-vs-msft): side-by-side comparisons of popular pairs with a plain verdict.
- [Economy](https://bullpeninvest.com/tools/economy): the latest Fed rate, CPI, jobs report and other releases against the previous reading.
- [Discover](https://bullpeninvest.com/discover): daily market overview — index moves, sector performance, and screened idea collections.
- [Academy](https://bullpeninvest.com/academy): free and Pro courses teaching investing fundamentals, from beginner to advanced.
- [Changelog](https://bullpeninvest.com/changelog): dated log of shipped product changes.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- Stock pages for S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 companies are open to crawlers (see `/robots.txt`); other
  tickers and `/asset/*` pages mostly are not. Prices on any crawled page are a snapshot: link the page
  for current data rather than quoting its price as live.
- Market data comes from Twelve Data; SEC filing data from EDGAR. BullPen does not originate market data.
- "Bull" is the in-product AI research assistant's name, distinct from BullPen the company/product.
